avis.texte: This is a very reputable brand with quality ingredients, however I won't be using this again. My skin looked dull and powdery. I absolutely love this sensitive skin mineral sunscreen spray, it's so convenient and non irritating! I live in the south and near the beach so sunscreen is a necessity for everyone in our household everyday. I prefer a mineral sunscreen so I was very excited to find a spray version that's also waterproof! This sunscreen is very easy to dispense and the nozzle gives a broad mist when you spray. This sunscreen sprays out like a white lotion so it still needs to be rubbed in slightly. This formula doesn't leave a white cast once it's rubbed in. I found this spray method to be easier to evenly coat my skin, especially on flare days when it's hard to use my hands. I really appreciate that this doesn't have any scent, my husband has sensitive skin and normally scented products irritate his skin. He didn't experience any irritation. This formula has aloe in it and I noticed my skin feels more moisturized! It also doesn't feel greasy or sticky. I love that this product is reef safe and is waterproof up to 80 minutes! If you are looking for a mineral sunscreen that sprays on and rubs in easily then I would highly recommend trying this, especially if you have sensitive skin!

I really like this Blue Lizard Sensitive Mineral Sunscreen. It works really well and you don't have to reapply it over and over again. It doesn't leave you with a pale white cast and it feels nice on the skin. Not much of a scent to it at all either. It sprays on really easily and protects well.

First time trying a Blue Lizard product and was really impressed. Easy to apply, just spray and go. Didn't leave no white residue like other sunscreens. Didn't look oily as well. I loved how it contains aloe giving it a soothing effect. It protects for a really long time before you have to reapply if needed. It doesn't have an overpowering scent.

I love this sunscreen because it doesn't give the oily feeling and it really is sensitive to all kinds of skin types. The twist cap is great. The spray range is awesome. I didn't smell anything which I actually like and the only bad thing is when you spray it too close it leaves a white spot that just stays there unless you rub it in only downside I have

I love the application of this product. Every time I have used it I have not gotten burnt. You do have to rub it in just a little bit because it is a mineral sunscreen, but that's not a big deal at all. The packaging is super cute as well. Would recommend!

avis.titre: New SPF must have for Summer!
avis.texte: The Blue Lizard Sensitive Mineral SPF 50 Spray is so so amazing for my sensitive skin. It goes on clear with quick drying and minimal scent. Love the color and packaging - all around, great product to have for summers.

This is truly the best sunscreen I've ever used… I will buy it again and again! It sprays on a white almost purple color, and absorbs quickly with one swipe. I used it exclusively for a week long Barbados vacation and didn't burn once!! Also never leaked. Huge fan!!!!

Works so much great doesn't give off a purple cast and I can see a difference in my skin when I use it. I love the packaging. It's easy to apply Minnie mouse sand, and it absorbs well in the skin. The texture feels nice on my skin and it actually has a nice smell
I love this sunscreen! Works great and has a nice scent. I used as instructed and didn't burn at all! I love that this has aloe in it for sensitive skin as well!
I absolutely love this sunscreen, I've taken it with me on all my summer vacations so far. It's the only sensitive sunscreen that doesn't make me break out. It has full coverage and easy to apply!

I bought this sunscreen because i'm pregnant and kept reading mineral sunscreens are a better option. I applied this sunblock liberally BEFORE going to the beach and when I got there. I burned right away. You could see where my face sunblock ended on my neck and where I used this on my chest, because my face and neck didn't burn. Also, it's way too expensive for the amount of product. One day at the beach and you'll use the whole can. I bought two, returned the one I didn't open.

This is a great very lightweight spray sunscreen! It's truly like it's not even there! It's pricey but feels so much better than man most sunscreen, it's worth it! Now I will say, I purchased the lotion after trying the spray and it was much heavier and did leave a white cast so I won't be using it again, but the spray is great!

avis.titre: Do I have a new favorite?
avis.texte: sensitive skin needs a good shake, but goes on without feeling oily or greasy. It also actually left my skin feeling nourished and I definitely can't say that about other sunscreens I've tried. This formula is reef safe making it environmentally friendly for your next beach getaway anddd infused with organic aloe (for more skin goodness). Highly recommend!

Love how it sprays, easy to apply on my kids. It preformed well for being out in the woods and on a full sunny day + splash pad with the kids. Didn't feel greasy, absorbed quickly. Will purchase again when this runs out.
Brought the sunscreen to our rocky point trip. It's awesome. Smell is good. Spray actually covers areas. It doesnt spray big drops but small drops.
